mind (partaking) of my powers. Whoever correctly  knows these powers and emanations of mine, becomes possessed of devotion free from indecision ;  of this (there is) no doubt. records.meaning_simple: The seven ancient sages and the four Manus. Fathers of all peoples. All were born from My mind, sharing My power.
